# Subscriber

## Summary
The party on the receiving end of subscriptions — who holds them, since
when, and which ones. Shared-realm block at `subscriber.gts`. The
Subscription card owns each plan's own life (price, billing cycle,
status); this card is the holder-side grouping that renewals, upgrade
prompts and "your plans" pages address.

## API
- `holder` — linksTo Contact
- `since` — DateField
- `subscriptions` — linksToMany Subscription (a small bounded set maintained by whatever command starts or stops one — the rollup rule's link-array case)
- `activeCount` — computed from the linked subscriptions' status

## Usage
```ts
import { Subscriber } from '../subscriber';

class SeasonTicketHolder extends Subscriber { /* seat, stand */ }
```

## Non-goals
Billing and plan lifecycle stay on Subscription; payment method and
invoicing are their own blocks. A subscriber is not a Loyalty Account —
holding a plan and accumulating standing are different relationships one
person can have separately, so an app that wants both links both to the
same Contact.
